analyzed_vuln.description: frame_decompress_chunk trusts the compressed chunk size returned by frame_get_lazychunk() and only checks `chunk_cbytes >= 4`, then reads `nbytes_ = sw32_(src + BLOSC2_CHUNK_NBYTES)`. BLOSC2_CHUNK_NBYTES is at offset 4, so this requires at least 8 bytes. With a malformed frame chunk whose declared size is 4..7 bytes, it performs an out-of-bounds/wild read in sw32_ (seen at blosc-private.h:90). Crash occurs in blosc_d while parsing stream sizes, but root cause is insufficient minimum chunk-header length validation before passing chunk data into decompression.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input is parsed as an in-memory frame via blosc2_schunk_from_buffer(). A crafted frame must produce at least one chunk where frame_get_lazychunk returns a short `chunk_cbytes` (>=4 but <8) and a `src` pointer not containing a full Blosc chunk header. The harness then calls blosc2_schunk_decompress_chunk -> frame_decompress_chunk -> blosc2_decompress_ctx/blosc_d, which reads header fields via sw32_ from invalid addresses and crashes.
